articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--As Trex Company, Inc. (NYSE:TREX) celebrates 30 years of innovation and impact, the company today announced the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report. Trex was the first company to bring wood composite decking to the market, creating an entirely new category of circular decking.
